tools.name: lookup_customer
tools.description: Looks up a customer profile by its unique customer identifier and returns the stored contact and account summary. Access to this tool is governed by the Purpose Binding policy: the caller must declare a processing purpose that is permitted for the tool (for example customer_support or billing); calls with a missing or disallowed purpose are rejected at the gateway before this tool is ever invoked.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose profile record should be retrieved from the store.

fullName.description: The customer's full legal name as recorded in the master profile store.

emailAddress.description: The customer's primary contact email address for account correspondence.

accountTier.description: The customer's subscription or loyalty tier, for example standard or premium.

lifetimeValue.description: The customer's lifetime value in US dollars, used for account prioritisation.
